cohort: The study included 92 extremely low birth weight infants (ELBWIs) who had delayed hyperthyrotropinemia, defined as a delayed rise in thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH) levels to >20 mIU/mL after initial normal TSH level.
finding: Early termination of levothyroxine replacement therapy (LRT) around the time of discharge from the NICU appears safe and feasible for well, clinically stable ELBWIs with delayed hyperthyrotropinemia, avoiding the risk of overtreatment.
